lines.text: در نوع انساني که اشرف و اکرم انواع مکنوناتست از این سبب گفته که بیت طالع خانه حیات
lines.en: In the human species, which is the noblest and most honorable of the species of created beings, for this reason it is said that the house of the ascendant is the house of life

lines.text: و نفس و ابتداء کارها و ایضا دلالت کند بر تدبیر مصالح و عزیمت امور و طلب اشیا و کیفیت
lines.en: and the soul and the beginning of affairs, and also it signifies the management of interests and the resolution of affairs and the seeking of things and the quality

lines.text: زندگاني و سعادت و شقاوت و از اعضا منسوبست بر و روي و بیت دویم مایل طالع
lines.en: of life and happiness and misery, and of the members it is attributed to the face and countenance, and the second house is inclined to the ascendant

lines.text: است دلالت کند بر حالت ثاني موجود که آن هر آینه کیفیت اسباب و انرا معني کذا
lines.en: it signifies the second state of the existent, which is certainly the quality of causes and its meaning is such

lines.text: خوانند و اقرب آن اسباب غذاست و اوسط آن ذخایر اموال و بعد از ان اعوان و
lines.en: they call it, and the closest of those causes is food, and the middle of them is the stores of wealth, and after that helpers and

lines.text: انصار از اینجهت گفته که بیت ثاني خانه مالست و معاش و اعوان و انصار و حوادث
lines.en: supporters, for this reason it is said that the second house is the house of wealth and livelihood and helpers and supporters and future events

lines.text: مستقبله و ایضا دلالت کند بر دخل و خرج و بقول بعضي بر اکل و شرب و از اعضا منسوبست
lines.en: and also it signifies income and expenditure, and according to some, eating and drinking, and of the members it is attributed

lines.text: بگردن و بیت سیم که زایل طالعست دلالت بحالت ثالث موجود و آن هر اینه کیفیت
lines.en: to the neck. And the third house, which is declining from the ascendant, signifies the third state of the existent, and that is inevitably the quality

lines.text: توابع اسباب معیشت است و چون حرکت سبب استمراء غذاست و برادر و خواهر که
lines.en: of the consequences of the causes of livelihood, and since movement is the cause of the digestion of food, and brothers and sisters who

lines.text: شریک و معین مالند و دلیل برایند وام خصومت ایشانست بسبب جلب اموال از
lines.en: are partners and helpers in wealth, and the indicator of the outcome of loans is their enmity because of the attraction of wealth. For

lines.text: اینجهت گفت که بیت ثالث خانه برادرانست و اقربا و سفرهاي نزدیک و تحویل از جائي
lines.en: this reason it is said that the third house is the house of brothers and relatives and short journeys and moving from one place

lines.text: بجاي و ایضا دلالت کند بر علم اندک و اسرار و از اعضا منسوبست بر دست و دوش
lines.en: to another, and also it signifies a little knowledge and secrets, and of the members it is attributed to the hand and shoulder

lines.text: و وتد چهارم چون در غایت خفاست علامت عواقب امور بود و امریکه ماده موجود
lines.en: and the fourth angle, since it is in the utmost concealment, is the sign of the consequences of affairs and the matter which is the material of the existent

lines.text: با و منتهي شود پدر و وضع محل قرار و ثباتست چون مسکن و املاک از این جهت گفته
lines.en: originates is the father, and the position of the place of rest and stability, like a dwelling and properties. For this reason, it is said

lines.text: بیت رابع خانه پدر و املاک و ضیاع و عقار و عواقب امور است و ایضا دلالت
lines.en: the fourth house is the house of the father, properties, estates, lands, and the outcomes of affairs. And also it signifies

lines.text: بر مدفن اموال و از اعضا منسوبست بسینه و پهلو و معده و پنجم که مایل رابعست هر
lines.en: the burial place of wealth, and of the members it is attributed to the chest and side and stomach, and the fifth, which is inclined to the fourth, every

lines.text: آینه دلیل دویم پدر بود که انفرزند است و اکل و شرب و هدایا که نتیجه املاک و
lines.en: mirror is the second reason of the father, which is the child, and eating and drinking and gifts, which are the result of properties and

lines.text: ارتفاعاتست از اینواسطه گفت که بیت خامس خانه فرزندان و رسولان و هدایا و
lines.en: crops, for this reason it is said that the fifth house is the house of children and messengers and gifts and

lines.text: اخبار و اکل و شربست و ایضا دالست بر عشقبازي و ملبوسات و شادي و سورها
lines.en: news and eating and drinking, and also it signifies lovemaking and clothing and joy and feasts

summary.headline: Meanings of the First Five Houses
summary.text: Judicial astrology explains the meanings of the first five houses: the ascendant as life, soul, affairs, and fortune; the second as wealth, livelihood, income, expenditure, and supporters; the third as siblings, relatives, short journeys, movement, knowledge, and secrets. It then treats the fourth as father, property, land, burial of wealth, and outcomes, and the fifth as children, messengers, gifts, news, food, drink, lovemaking, clothing, joy, and feasts, with bodily correspondences.
